description: rcrisp is an R package for drawing consistent boundaries around urban river corridors. The CityRiverSpaces README says the method combines the form of a river valley with overlapping built fabric so that social and environmental measurements can be compared within a defensible riverside area. Users supply terrain, river and urban spatial inputs; outputs are mapped delineations for the selected city. Geographic coverage follows the city and input layers, not a fixed national dataset. The package DESCRIPTION states Apache License version 2 or later. A limitation is that a morphological corridor is not a flood-inundation map; results depend on terrain resolution and choices about urban form. rcrisp can define exposure zones for riverfront buildings and flood-defence scenarios. The related QGIS catalogue platform offers general GIS analysis but not this delineation method. No urban layers or package were downloaded.
name: rcrisp riverside urban-area delineator
